_doc: Every mod this project ships, for tools/kit.py (package, deploy, check) and pr/MODDING.md.
Paths are relative to pr/. A mod is a BepInEx plugin, a Magicite data folder, or both:
name          folder name: BepInEx/plugins/<name> and Magicite/<name>
game          ff1..ff6 (the plugin is built against that game's code)
plugin        project: the plugin's folder (dotnet build -c Release); files/dirs: [source, name in the plugin folder]
magicite      the built Magicite folder; magicite_skip: file names left out of it
build         commands run from pr/ before the plugin is built (data scripts); {python} = the venv's
exclusive     mods sharing this tag are never installed together (deploy shelves the others)
keep          plugin sub-folders a reinstall leaves in place (player data, e.g. WC's seeds)
deploy        a mod's own deploy command, used instead of the generic one
version / version_file + version_key: the package's version suffix
package_leave_out  plugin-folder paths the zip leaves out (made on the player's machine from their game);
package_magicite false: the Magicite folder too; player_setup: the script the plugin
runs to make them (the packager checks the plugin's DLL names it)
readme_note   extra paragraph in the package README

bc.name: BeyondChaos
bc.title: Beyond Chaos CE 6.1.3 for FINAL FANTASY VI Pixel Remaster
bc.readme_note:
Version 0.1.0, the first playable release (a Pre-release: expect rough edges).

Making a seed: on the title screen, choose "Beyond Chaos". Pick a preset (New Player, Intermediate,
Advanced, Chaotic, Race Easy/Medium/Insane) or paste Beyond Chaos flags (Ctrl+V), type a seed or leave
a random one, then "Generate and play this seed" and start a New Game. A seed takes one to two minutes
to make (Chaotic, with remonsterate's monster pictures, takes longest). Saves remember their
seed. A seed, mode and flags make the same game as Beyond Chaos CE 6.1.3's own randomizer: it's made in
the game by Beyond Chaos's own code (bundled Python, no SNES ROM needed; the game's own files are read
from your copy of the game on the first start). Each seed comes with a short guide to what Beyond Chaos
changed, shown after the opening's controls tutorial.

What's carried over: BC's randomized characters, commands, espers, items, shops, chests, monsters and
their AI, formations and encounters, the Colosseum, natural magic, character and monster names, its new
character art (makeover) and monster pictures (remonsterate), its music (johnnydmad), and most of its
codes and light event changes. The options screen marks every flag: carried, partly carried, not yet,
or no bearing on the Pixel Remaster.

Not yet: the race and cave modes (Kefka @ Narshe, Ancient Cave, Speed Cave, Race Cave, Dragon Hunt:
use Normal), the `d` dungeon remap, Divergent paths (thescenarionottaken) and the flags
marked "not yet" on the options screen. strangejourney is partly in (most doors are
rewired; some story-version doors keep their own targets). Gau doesn't start with an empty rage list under `o` yet.

Beyond Chaos is by Abyssonym and the Beyond Chaos Community Edition team (MIT license:
BepInEx/BeyondChaos/generator/bc/LICENSE.txt). Its art and music come from the Beyond Chaos community's
packs, bundled with their authors' permission.

This is a mod of its own: don't install it beside the project's other game-data mods (Brave New
World, Worlds Collide). Start a new game after installing.
